item.title: Mirror 1.3.1
item.description: - The control panel stays put when you turn the soft light on, so you can turn it straight back off - With the soft light on, the panel turns light gray and sits centered in the light - The soft light uses your screen's extra HDR brightness when it has it, so it can get much brighter - New reset button (or press 0): back to the plain picture, everything off - New tagline in About: A quick look. - View → Fit Window to Camera (⌘0): the camera's own shape with no zoom, for the sharpest, uncropped picture - The window keeps to sensible shapes (3:4 to 2:1), so the picture never gets cropped to a sliver
